findings.description: The implementation uses (amount_cents * percent + 50) // 100 which does not round halves away from zero for negative amounts. For example, percent_of(-1, 50) returns 0 but should return -1 to satisfy spec that percent_of(-x, p) == -percent_of(x, p).

review.summary: Incorrect rounding behavior for negative amounts when product is an exact half.
